---
title: "Map"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
attacks <- read_csv("data/attacks_clean.csv") |>
  mutate(
    Country_lower = str_to_lower(str_trim(Country)),
    Fatal_clean = case_when(
      Fatal == "Y" ~ "Fatal",
      Fatal == "N" ~ "Non-fatal",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  )

write_rds(attacks, "data/attacks.rds")
```

```{r}
attack_counts <- attacks |>
  count(Country_lower, name = "attacks")

world_map <- map_data("world") |>
  mutate(region = str_to_lower(region)) |>
  left_join(attack_counts, by = c("region" = "Country_lower"))

ggplot(world_map, aes(long, lat, group = group, fill = attacks)) +
  geom_polygon(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "lightyellow",
    high = "darkred",
    trans = "sqrt",
    na.value = "grey90",
    name = "Attacks"
  ) +
  coord_quickmap() +
  labs(title = "Shark attacks by country") +
  theme_void()
```

## Fatal vs. non-fatal attacks

Only records marked `Y` or `N` are counted; unknown, missing, and other values are excluded.

```{r}
attacks |>
  filter(Fatal %in% c("Y", "N")) |>
  mutate(Outcome = recode(Fatal, Y = "Fatal", N = "Non-fatal")) |>
  count(Outcome)
```
